---
title: "Contact & Service Request"
page-layout: full
---

Tell me about your life-sciences data challenge. I'll review the details and follow up by email.

Please use this form for consulting inquiries involving genomics, proteomics, RNA-seq, single-cell analysis, antibody data, scientific data platforms, or applied AI. You do not need to have every detail finalized; reasonable estimates are fine.

```{=html}
<form id="service-request-form"
      action="https://formsubmit.co/sridhara.omics@gmail.com"
      method="POST">

  <input type="hidden"
         name="_subject"
         id="email_subject"
         value="New life-sciences consulting inquiry">

  <input type="hidden"
         name="_template"
         value="table">

  <!-- Optional: disable captcha -->
  <!-- <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="false"> -->

  <!-- Spam-prevention honeypot -->
  <input type="text"
         name="_honey"
         tabindex="-1"
         autocomplete="off"
         style="display:none">

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="name" class="form-label">Your name</label>
    <input id="name"
           name="name"
           type="text"
           class="form-control"
           autocomplete="name"
           required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="email" class="form-label">Email address</label>
    <input id="email"
           name="email"
           type="email"
           class="form-control"
           autocomplete="email"
           required>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="data_type" class="form-label">Primary data type</label>

    <select id="data_type"
            name="data_type"
            class="form-select"
            required>

      <option value="" selected disabled>
        Select the closest match
      </option>

      <option value="Genome / genomics">Genome / genomics</option>
      <option value="Proteome / proteomics">Proteome / proteomics</option>
      <option value="Bulk RNA-seq">Bulk RNA-seq</option>
      <option value="Single-cell data">Single-cell data</option>
      <option value="Antibody sequencing / repertoire">
        Antibody sequencing / repertoire
      </option>
      <option value="Multiple or mixed data types">
        Multiple or mixed data types
      </option>
      <option value="Other life-sciences data">
        Other life-sciences data
      </option>
    </select>

    <div class="form-text">
      If your project involves several data types, mention the others below.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="datasets_size" class="form-label">
      Datasets and approximate data size
    </label>

    <textarea id="datasets_size"
              name="datasets_size"
              class="form-control"
              rows="3"
              maxlength="1000"
              placeholder="Dataset accession or link, number of samples, file types, and estimated size (e.g. 20 GB or 3 TB)."
              required></textarea>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="analysis" class="form-label">
      What kind of analysis or support do you need?
    </label>

    <input id="analysis"
           name="analysis"
           type="text"
           class="form-control"
           maxlength="100"
           placeholder="Build a reproducible single-cell RNA-seq pipeline"
           required>

    <div class="form-text">
      Maximum 100 characters. This description will be included in the email subject.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="mb-3">
    <label for="description" class="form-label">
      Detailed description
    </label>

    <textarea id="description"
              name="description"
              class="form-control"
              rows="6"
              minlength="100"
              maxlength="1000"
              placeholder="Describe the goals, expected outputs, tools or cloud environment, timeline, and any constraints."
              required></textarea>

    <div class="form-text">
      Required: 100–1,000 characters.
    </div>
  </div>

  <p class="small text-muted">
    Please share project metadata only. Do not include patient-identifiable
    information, credentials, confidential data, or proprietary sequences.
  </p>

  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
    Send Service Request
  </button>

</form>

<script>
document.getElementById("service-request-form")
  .addEventListener("submit", function () {

    const name =
      document.getElementById("name").value.trim();

    const analysis =
      document.getElementById("analysis").value.trim();

    document.getElementById("email_subject").value =
      "Service request - " + name + " - " + analysis;
});
</script>
```
